title: Chunky Guacamole with Tortilla Chips
summary: A fresh Mexican-style chunky guacamole with creamy avocado, lime, coriander, tomato and a little chilli, served with crisp corn tortilla chips. It is quick to make for a vegan snack, party bowl or pre-dinner nibble.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil, for brushing the chips

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan. Cut the corn tortillas into triangles and spread them over a baking tray in a single layer.
Brush the tortilla wedges lightly with vegetable oil and bake for 8–10 minutes, turning once, until crisp and lightly golden at the edges. Leave to cool; they will crisp a little more as they cool.
Halve and stone the avocados, then scoop the flesh into a bowl. Add the lime juice and salt, then mash roughly with a fork, leaving plenty of chunks.
Fold in the red onion, diced tomato, coriander, chilli, garlic and black pepper. Taste and add a little more lime juice or salt if needed.
Spoon the chunky guacamole into a serving bowl and serve straight away with the crisp tortilla chips.
